scalars.scalar_value: Demonstrated experience in updating and utilizing a mission critical database to enter, maintain, or to relay information in comprehensive manner. Experience in use of a fundraising/donor database preferred (Blackbaud CRM or other Blackbaud products).
Days, 8 hrs/day, Monday-Friday, hybrid work schedule

items.item_text: Access to transportation.
Occasional overtime may be required.
Job offer is contingent upon satisfactory clearance based on Background Check results.

Demonstrated experience in updating and utilizing a mission critical database to enter, maintain, or to relay information in comprehensive manner. Experience in use of a fundraising/donor database preferred (Blackbaud CRM or other Blackbaud products).
Working knowledge of the dynamics of fundraising and the concepts of development and advancement for an academic institution. Experience managing data as it relates to these concepts, preferred.
Proven experience in high volume, mission critical data processing using a PC with fast and accurate data entry and typing skills with a minimum of 15,000 SPH or comparable skill at 60 WPM.

UC San Diego Advancement's dynamic team inspires, builds and nurtures relationships with our community — alumni, students, faculty, staff and other members of the Triton family — that increase engagement with and philanthropic support for the university. Together, Advancement’s six units bring together strategy, partnerships and expertise to support UC San Diego’s efforts to unite diverse people and unconventional perspectives to propel limitless impact here in San Diego and far beyond.

Central Advancement is a division of Advancement that provides professional services and resources, strategic guidance, and expertise to leverage the assets of the UC San Diego community, infusing insight into philanthropic strategy and action.

Central Advancement aligns central programs and services — including Advancement and Campaign Communications, Annual Giving, Donor Experience and Engagement, Prospect Development, and Training — to support the success of our fundraising enterprise. These teams provide world-class service, tools, expertise, resources and strategic guidance for partners across Advancement to maximize and communicate the impact of philanthropy on our students, researchers, clinicians, scientists and community members in San Diego and beyond.

The Data Operations Assistant will provide data maintenance and support as part of the Advancement Systems Management Team. This position is responsible for reviewing, updating, and leveraging control reports that find and correct errors and discrepancies in the constituent database, Blackbaud CRM (“ESP”). This position will also assist in updating policies and procedures, as well as other team and department documentation. This position will serve as back-up to the Data Operations Analyst in importing and entering information into our constituent database, via manual entry and various import tools.

This position will be responsible for special projects determined by the Data Operations Analyst and Senior Data Operations Analyst as needed. Additionally, this position will interact with all levels of Advancement via a customer service role by providing necessary updates that meet data integrity and service delivery standards. This position is responsible for independent problem-solving and performing duties with high-quality service, utmost courtesy and confidentiality, using a group-process approach to accomplishing work.
Demonstrated competency and commitment to equity, diversity and inclusion.

Proficiency in adapting computer software programs to meet office needs. Proficient in the use of software applications necessary in administrative work, including database to retrieve current and historical information to compile reports and briefings, spreadsheets, and graphics programs and the ability to implement new systems to increase productivity, using e-mail, word processing, spreadsheet, and calendar applications.
Strong working knowledge of Excel and preferably, Blackbaud CRM or other Blackbaud products.
Knowledge of the techniques of donor/prospect research with the ability to extract and distill pertinent/critical information from multiple sources.
Ability to analyze diverse correspondence/documentation to insure complete and accurate information has been received, and application of appropriate updates is made.
Demonstrated high degree of integrity, dependability, use of sound judgment, diplomacy and resourcefulness, with a strong work ethic.

Proven excellent organizational skills. Demonstrated ability to prioritize workload, meet deadlines, and work with frequent interruptions under constantly changing priorities in a fast-paced operation while exhibiting extreme attention to detail and high degree of accuracy at all times. Ability to work in a very busy interactive environment with frequent interruptions and to perform tasks accurately and quickly. Demonstrated ability to be detail oriented and thorough in completion of tasks.

Resourcefulness in independently finding appropriate solutions to complex problems, operational and administrative, and use of initiative in implementing solutions or making recommendations. Ability to anticipate problems and take necessary actions to mitigate potential negative effects.
Ability to encourage and develop a collaborative and positive environment among colleagues.

Demonstrated interpersonal and oral skills with the ability to interact in a positive manner with diverse and demanding clientele, including major gift prospects, donors, volunteers, prominent social, business, and governmental figures, and campus administrators, using a high degree of tact, diplomacy, and discretion, with emphasis of flexibility and professionalism.
Proven ability to utilize total quality service as a work philosophy; demonstrated willingness to work as part of a team.
